data.text:
Karthikeyan T.K vs K.P. Musthafa Food Safety Officer ... on 9 
April, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.3764/2023 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Tuesday, the 9th day of April 2024 / 20th Chaithra, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2023 In Crl.Mc No. 3764 Of 2023
 Cc 1928/2020 Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -Ii,Hosdrug, Kasargod
 Petitioners/Petitioners:
 Karthikeyan T.K. Aged 61 Years S/O Govindan T.K. Muzhakkom,
 Valiyapoll P.O. Cheruvathur Kasargod Dist (Fbo) M/S Twenty-20 Super
 Market Dr. No. 32/696 A1, Weavers Street, Nileswar P.O., Kasargod
 District Pin - 671314
 And 3 Others
 Respondents/Respondent:
 K.P. Musthafa Food Safety Officer Trikaripur Circle Nr. Village
 Office Nileswar Pin - 671314
 And 2 Others
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
 High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in C.C. 1928/2020
 pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Ii, Hosdurg,
 pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case.
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the
 application along with connected cases and this court's order dated
 12/10/2023 in Crl.M.A.1/2023 and upon hearing the arguments of Mr. Premjit
 Nagendran, Advocate for the petitioner and the Public Prosecutor for R1
 and R2 and of Standing Counsel for R3 , the court passed the following:
 Order 
Interim order shall stand extended by three months. 
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 09-04-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Karthikeyan T.K vs K.P. Musthafa Food Safety Officer ... on 9 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174298652/
